Applebee’s Happy Hour: Menu Delights and Timings Explained

Applebee’s, a renowned neighborhood grill, is a leading casual dining restaurant chain known for its welcoming atmosphere and mouth-watering American fare. With locations across the United States, Applebee’s has become a go-to spot for friends, families, and coworkers to gather, eat, and unwind. One of the most popular attractions is the Applebee’s Happy Hour, where guests can indulge in fantastic food and drink specials at discounted prices. This twice-daily event offers a happy hour experience filled with tasty appetizers and refreshing drinks, making it an excellent way to enjoy the best of Applebee’s without breaking the bank.

Applebee’s happy hour specials feature a mix of half-priced appetizers, 2-for-1 drink deals, and other exclusive offers that cater to a variety of tastes. Whether you’re a fan of their boneless wings, mozzarella sticks, or creamy spinach and artichoke dip, there’s something for everyone. If you’re interested in how happy hour works at other casual dining restaurants, check out this in-depth guide to happy hour deals at casual dining chains. Let’s dive into the details of Applebee’s Happy Hour, including the schedule, menu, and what makes it a standout choice for your next outing.

Happy Hour Details

Applebee’s Happy Hour Times

Applebee’s happy hour times vary slightly by location, but the typical schedule runs from 3 PM to 6 PM and resumes again from 9 PM until closing time. These hours provide two perfect opportunities each day to enjoy half-price appetizers, discounted drinks, and the lively neighborhood grill ambiance. If you’re looking to unwind after work or need a late-night snack, Applebee’s happy hour has got you covered and for those who want to compare options, here’s a helpful resource for finding the best late-night food deals in your area.

Happy Hour Menu

Applebee’s Happy Hour Menu

Applebee’s happy hour menu offers an enticing selection of appetizers and drinks at discounted prices, making it a popular choice for those looking to unwind without spending too much. Below are some of the most popular items available during happy hour. If you love discovering appetizers, this guide to the most popular American appetizers might give you even more ideas for what to order next time.

Popular Appetizers:

  • Boneless Wings: Tender, juicy wings tossed in your choice of sauce.

    If you love Applebee’s boneless wings at home, try the Buffalo Wild Wings Sauce Variety Pack or the Frank’s RedHot Buffalo Wing Sauce to make your own wings.
  • Mozzarella Sticks: Crispy on the outside, melty on the inside, served with marinara sauce.

  • Long Island Iced Tea: A classic cocktail combining gin, vodka, rum, tequila, and triple sec.

    Combine with your cocktail shaker set and margarita salt rimmer for a perfect drink experience.

Additional Specials

Applebee’s Specials and Secret Menu Items

Beyond the regular happy hour specials, Applebee’s also offers late-night deals and secret menu items that can enhance your dining experience. Some highlights include:

  • Late-Night Deals: From 9 PM until closing, enjoy half-priced appetizers and special drink discounts. This is perfect for night owls and those looking for a late-night snack.
  • Secret Menu Items: While not officially listed, Applebee’s may offer exclusive dishes and drinks during happy hour. Don’t hesitate to ask your server about any available specials.

History of Applebee’s

History of Applebee’s Grill & Bar

Applebee’s has a rich history dating back to its founding in 1980 in Decatur, Georgia. Initially known as Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill & Bar, the restaurant quickly gained popularity for its friendly service and comforting American dishes. Over the years, Applebee’s has expanded its footprint, now boasting locations across the United States and internationally.

Key milestones include:

  • 1980: The first Applebee’s opens, offering a casual dining experience that quickly becomes popular.
  • 1990s: Rapid expansion across the U.S., introducing signature items like the boneless wings and spinach and artichoke dip.
  • 2007: Applebee’s is acquired by Dine Brands Global, helping to solidify its position as a leader in the grill and bar category.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQs on Applebee’s Happy Hour

1. What are the Applebee’s Happy Hour times?

  • Applebee’s typically runs happy hour from 3 PM to 6 PM and 9 PM until closing time, but this can vary by location.

2. Are there any half-price appetizers at Applebee’s?

  • Yes, Applebee’s offers half-price appetizers during happy hour, including favorites like mozzarella sticks and boneless wings.

3. Do all Applebee’s locations participate in Happy Hour?

  • While most Applebee’s locations participate, participation may vary, so it’s best to check your local restaurant.

4. Can I get drink specials during Happy Hour?

  • Absolutely! Enjoy a variety of drink specials, including 2-for-1 deals on select beers and cocktails.

5. What are Applebee’s operating hours?

  • Operating hours generally range from 11 AM to 12 AM on weekdays and 11 AM to 1 AM on weekends, but these hours may vary.

Conclusion

Applebee’s happy hour is the perfect way to enjoy your favorite appetizers and drinks at discounted prices. With two daily happy hours and a wide range of menu options, you can easily find something to satisfy your cravings. Whether it’s the creamy spinach and artichoke dip, a refreshing house margarita, or the crowd-favorite boneless wings, Applebee’s has something for everyone.

Join the Fun at Applebee’s

Visit your local Applebee’s today to take advantage of these great deals, and make sure to check their website for the latest specials and happy hour times. Don’t miss out on the chance to enjoy the neighborhood grill experience with fantastic food and drinks at unbeatable prices!
